Improved Counterspell: Can counterspell using a higher-level spell from the same school
Mutagen: 1 hr process creates potions that give self +2 Armor Class and +4/-2 to Strength/Intelligence, Dexterity/Wisdom, or Constitution/Charisma for 100 min

Spell Suppression: May use Bardic Performance to counter Spellcraft-identified spell of level equal to or less than performance rds
Suggestion: Can use Suggestion effects on 1 fascinated creature
Swift Alchemy: May create alchemical items in half normal time
Wand Mastery: Uses Charisma bonus to calculate save DC of spells cast from wands
Widen Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 3 levels higher than normal to double its area of affect
